_doc: Curated agronomic parameters. t_* in C, rain in mm over the season, ph unitless, nutrients kg/ha, gdd in C-days above t_base, kc = FAO-56 crop coefficients, stage_frac = fraction of season per FAO stage (ini/dev/mid/late), ky = FAO-33 yield response factors per stage, yield in t/ha, price in INR per quintal, cost in INR per ha.

tips.sowing: Transplant 21-25 day seedlings at 20x15 cm; June to July for kharif.
tips.irrigation: Keep 2-5 cm standing water until grain fill; drain 10 days before harvest.
tips.fertilizer: Split nitrogen in three doses: basal, tillering, panicle initiation.
tips.pests: Stem borer and leaf folder: pheromone traps, cartap hydrochloride if above threshold.
tips.harvest: Harvest at 20-22% grain moisture when 80% of panicles are straw coloured.

tips.sowing: Sow 1-25 November at 100 kg/ha seed; late sowing after 15 December costs 1% yield per day.
tips.irrigation: Crown root initiation at 21 days is the single most important irrigation; then tillering, jointing, flowering, milk.
tips.fertilizer: Half nitrogen and all phosphorus and potash at sowing; rest of nitrogen at first irrigation.
tips.pests: Yellow rust in cool humid Februaries: propiconazole at first pustules. Aphids at heading.
tips.harvest: Harvest when grain is hard and straw turns golden, around 130 days.

tips.sowing: Ridge sowing at 60x20 cm, 20 kg/ha seed; avoid waterlogging in the first three weeks.
tips.irrigation: Critical at knee-high, tasseling and grain fill. Silking drought costs the most yield.
tips.fertilizer: Nitrogen in three splits: basal, knee-high, pre-tasseling. Add 25 kg/ha zinc sulphate if deficient.
tips.pests: Fall armyworm: scout whorls weekly, emamectin benzoate or spinetoram if more than 10% plants damaged.
tips.harvest: Cobs at 25-30% grain moisture with black layer visible at kernel base.

tips.sowing: Sow with first monsoon showers, 4 kg/ha seed at 45x15 cm.
tips.irrigation: Rain-fed in most tracts; one life-saving irrigation at flowering in dry spells.
tips.fertilizer: Half nitrogen basal, half at 30 days. Responds well to farmyard manure.
tips.pests: Downy mildew: use resistant hybrids and metalaxyl seed treatment.
tips.harvest: Harvest ear heads when grains harden, roughly 80-90 days.

tips.sowing: Kharif sowing with monsoon onset; rabi sowing late September on residual moisture in black soils.
tips.irrigation: Largely rain-fed; irrigate at boot and grain fill if available.
tips.fertilizer: Nitrogen in two splits; phosphorus basal.
tips.pests: Shoot fly in late sowings: seed treatment with imidacloprid and early sowing.
tips.harvest: Harvest when grains are hard and cannot be dented by thumbnail.

tips.sowing: Sow by mid November, 90 kg/ha seed; tolerates salinity better than wheat.
tips.irrigation: Two irrigations: tillering and grain filling.
tips.fertilizer: Low nitrogen; excess lodges the crop and hurts malting grade.
tips.pests: Aphids and covered smut; carboxin seed treatment.
tips.harvest: Harvest at full straw yellowing, 115-125 days.

tips.sowing: June-July, 15 kg/ha seed with Rhizobium; ridges in heavy soils to avoid waterlogging.
tips.irrigation: Rain-fed; one irrigation at pod fill in dry autumns doubles yield.
tips.fertilizer: Starter nitrogen only; phosphorus and sulphur basal.
tips.pests: Pod borer (Helicoverpa): pheromone traps, HaNPV, then indoxacarb at pod set.
tips.harvest: Harvest when 75% pods turn brown.

tips.sowing: October to early November on conserved moisture, 75 kg/ha seed.
tips.irrigation: Usually one irrigation at flowering; over-irrigation causes excess vegetative growth.
tips.fertilizer: Diammonium phosphate basal; Rhizobium and PSB seed treatment.
tips.pests: Pod borer: neem seed kernel extract early, then spinosad.
tips.harvest: Harvest when leaves turn reddish-brown and pods dry.

tips.sowing: Late October to mid November, 40 kg/ha; relay sow into standing rice in eastern India.
tips.irrigation: One light irrigation at pod formation if the winter is dry.
tips.fertilizer: Phosphorus basal; avoid nitrogen beyond starter dose.
tips.pests: Rust and wilt: resistant varieties, avoid waterlogging.
tips.harvest: Harvest when pods turn brown, before shattering.

tips.sowing: Mid October to November, 80 kg/ha seed at 30x10 cm.
tips.irrigation: Light irrigations at flowering and pod fill; peas hate waterlogging.
tips.fertilizer: Phosphorus rich basal dose; Rhizobium inoculation.
tips.pests: Powdery mildew in late season: wettable sulphur.
tips.harvest: Green pods at 60-70 days, dry seed at 100 days.

tips.sowing: Late June to early July with 100 mm cumulative rain, 75 kg/ha seed on broad-bed-furrows.
tips.irrigation: Rain-fed; irrigate at pod fill in September dry spells.
tips.fertilizer: Phosphorus, potash and 20 kg/ha sulphur basal; Bradyrhizobium seed treatment.
tips.pests: Girdle beetle and semilooper: quinalphos or chlorantraniliprole at threshold.
tips.harvest: Harvest when 95% pods turn brown and leaves drop.

tips.sowing: June-July or January-February, 100 kg/ha kernels; light soils for easy pegging.
tips.irrigation: Critical at pegging and pod development; avoid waterlogging.
tips.fertilizer: Gypsum 250 kg/ha at pegging for calcium; phosphorus basal.
tips.pests: Leaf miner and tikka leaf spot: chlorothalonil at first spots.
tips.harvest: Harvest when inner shell turns dark and seed coat pink.

tips.sowing: First fortnight of October, 5 kg/ha seed at 30x10 cm.
tips.irrigation: Pre-flowering at 30 days and pod formation at 60 days.
tips.fertilizer: Sulphur 40 kg/ha lifts oil content; half nitrogen basal, half at first irrigation.
tips.pests: Aphid after flowering: dimethoate only if colonies cover more than 10% plants.
tips.harvest: Harvest when 75% siliquae turn yellow, before shattering.

tips.sowing: Broadcast 4 kg/ha seed mixed with sand; needs a light seedbed and no waterlogging.
tips.irrigation: Rain-fed; extremely sensitive to standing water.
tips.fertilizer: Light nitrogen; excess promotes leaf over capsules.
tips.pests: Phyllody and leaf webber: rogue infected plants, neem oil.
tips.harvest: Cut when lower capsules brown, stack upright to ripen.

tips.sowing: Photo-insensitive; 5 kg/ha hybrid seed at 60x30 cm in any season.
tips.irrigation: Bud initiation, flowering and seed fill are critical; 2-3 irrigations.
tips.fertilizer: Boron 0.2% spray at ray floret opening improves seed set.
tips.pests: Head borer and birds: hand collection, bird scaring near maturity.
tips.harvest: Harvest when back of head turns lemon yellow.

tips.sowing: Late September to October on residual moisture in deep black soils.
tips.irrigation: Deep-rooted; one irrigation at flowering if possible.
tips.fertilizer: Modest nitrogen; phosphorus basal.
tips.pests: Aphid: early sowing escapes peak; dimethoate at threshold.
tips.harvest: Harvest when heads dry and leaves brown, using gloves for spines.

tips.sowing: April-May irrigated north, June-July rain-fed south; Bt hybrids at 90x60 cm.
tips.irrigation: Square and boll formation are critical; drip saves 40% water.
tips.fertilizer: Nitrogen in four splits; magnesium sulphate spray for reddening.
tips.pests: Pink bollworm: pheromone traps at 5/ha, timely termination of crop, no extended season.
tips.harvest: Pick fully opened bolls in 3-4 rounds, in dry mornings.

tips.sowing: March-April with pre-monsoon showers, 5 kg/ha seed in lines.
tips.irrigation: Needs a pre-sowing irrigation in dry Marches; then monsoon.
tips.fertilizer: Nitrogen in two splits; responds to potash.
tips.pests: Stem weevil and yellow mite: neem oil, sulphur.
tips.harvest: Harvest at 120 days at early pod stage for best fibre; ret in clean slow-moving water.

tips.sowing: Autumn (October) or spring (February-March) planting of three-bud setts in 90 cm furrows.
tips.irrigation: Formative phase (60-130 days) is critical; trash mulch cuts water use by 30%.
tips.fertilizer: Nitrogen in 3-4 splits up to 120 days; press mud and potash basal.
tips.pests: Early shoot borer: trash mulch, Trichogramma cards, avoid late planting.
tips.harvest: Harvest at 10-12 months when Brix exceeds 18; ratoon once or twice.

tips.sowing: Mid October to November, 2.5 t/ha of 30-40 g seed tubers at 60x20 cm.
tips.irrigation: Light frequent irrigations; keep ridges moist at tuber initiation (25-45 days).
tips.fertilizer: Potash-heavy; half nitrogen at planting, half at earthing up.
tips.pests: Late blight in cool cloudy weeks: mancozeb protectant, cymoxanil+mancozeb on first lesion.
tips.harvest: Dehaulm 10 days before digging so skins set; 90-100 days.

tips.sowing: Rabi: nursery October, transplant December at 15x10 cm. Kharif: nursery June.
tips.irrigation: Frequent light irrigation; stop 10-15 days before harvest for storage quality.
tips.fertilizer: Sulphur 30 kg/ha improves pungency and storage.
tips.pests: Thrips and purple blotch: blue sticky traps, mancozeb.
tips.harvest: Harvest when 50% tops fall over; cure in shade for a week.

tips.sowing: Nursery 25 days; transplant at 60x45 cm with staking for hybrids.
tips.irrigation: Drip with mulch; uneven water at fruit set causes cracking and blossom-end rot.
tips.fertilizer: Calcium and boron sprays at fruit set; fertigation weekly.
tips.pests: Leaf curl virus via whitefly: yellow sticky traps, reflective mulch, resistant hybrids.
tips.harvest: Pick at breaker stage for distant markets, red-ripe for local.

tips.sowing: Nursery 30-35 days; transplant at 60x60 cm.
tips.irrigation: Weekly in summer, fortnightly in winter.
tips.fertilizer: Split nitrogen every month during picking.
tips.pests: Shoot and fruit borer: remove infested shoots weekly, pheromone traps at 100/ha.
tips.harvest: Pick tender fruits every 4-5 days for 3 months.

tips.sowing: February-March and June-July, 10 kg/ha seed soaked overnight, 45x30 cm.
tips.irrigation: Every 4-5 days in summer.
tips.fertilizer: Nitrogen half basal, rest in two splits.
tips.pests: Yellow vein mosaic via whitefly: resistant varieties, remove infected plants.
tips.harvest: Pick 3-4 day old tender pods every alternate day.

tips.sowing: Nursery September-October; transplant 4-week seedlings at 45x45 cm.
tips.irrigation: Regular light irrigation; irregular water splits heads.
tips.fertilizer: Nitrogen in three splits; boron deficiency causes hollow stem.
tips.pests: Diamondback moth: Bt spray, trap crop of mustard every 25 rows.
tips.harvest: Harvest firm heads at 90-100 days.

tips.sowing: Choose maturity group by transplant month: early (June-July), mid (August-September), late (October).
tips.irrigation: Keep curd-forming plants evenly moist.
tips.fertilizer: Molybdenum and boron prevent whiptail and browning.
tips.pests: Diamondback moth and aphids: Bt, neem oil.
tips.harvest: Harvest compact white curds before they loosen; blanch by tying leaves.

tips.sowing: September to November, 5 kg/ha seed on raised beds in deep loose soil.
tips.irrigation: Light frequent watering; dry-wet cycles crack roots.
tips.fertilizer: Avoid fresh manure, it forks roots. Potash for colour.
tips.pests: Carrot fly, nematodes: crop rotation.
tips.harvest: Lift at 90-100 days when shoulders reach 2-3 cm.

tips.sowing: Sow every 3 weeks from September to February for a continuous supply.
tips.irrigation: Every 4-6 days.
tips.fertilizer: Nitrogen top-dress after each cutting.
tips.pests: Leaf miner: remove mined leaves; neem.
tips.harvest: First cutting at 30-35 days, then every 15 days.

tips.sowing: Nursery 35-40 days; transplant at 60x45 cm in June-July or October.
tips.irrigation: Never let flowering plants wilt; drip is ideal.
tips.fertilizer: Nitrogen in four splits over picking period.
tips.pests: Thrips and mites cause leaf curl: fipronil, spiromesifen; avoid over-spraying.
tips.harvest: Green pods from 75 days; red dry pods after 150 days.

tips.sowing: April-June, 2.5 t/ha mother rhizomes on raised beds with 12 t/ha farmyard manure.
tips.irrigation: Weekly in dry spells; mulch heavily.
tips.fertilizer: Potash-heavy; nitrogen in three splits at 45, 90, 120 days.
tips.pests: Rhizome rot in waterlogged beds: Trichoderma-treated seed, drainage.
tips.harvest: Dig at 8-9 months when leaves dry; boil, dry and polish.

tips.sowing: July with monsoon onset, 15 kg/ha seed at 45x15 cm in sandy soils.
tips.irrigation: Drought-hardy; rain-fed.
tips.fertilizer: Starter nitrogen and phosphorus only.
tips.pests: Bacterial blight: streptocycline seed treatment.
tips.harvest: Harvest when pods dry, around 100 days.
